emails.title: Email addresses
emails.description: Email addresses to validate (one per line). Duplicates are skipped.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Domain names to check for A, MX, SPF and DMARC records (no mailbox).

csvUrl.title: CSV URL (optional)
csvUrl.description: HTTP(S) URL of a CSV file with an email and/or domain column. Combined with the lists above, then deduped.

csvEmailColumn.title: CSV email column
csvEmailColumn.description: Column name for emails. Leave empty to auto-detect (email, e-mail, mail, …).

csvDomainColumn.title: CSV domain column
csvDomainColumn.description: Column name for domains. Leave empty to auto-detect (domain, website, url, …).

suggestTypos.title: Suggest typo fixes
suggestTypos.description: Suggest a corrected domain for common typos such as gmial.com or gmail.con.

maxItems.title: Max results
maxItems.description: Hard cap on validated (and charged) unique emails and domains in this run.
